name: Earnings Desk
author: Sachiv
summary: Tracks company earnings releases and produces structured Word reports with industry-specific performance indicators.
starterPrompt: Create an earnings watchlist for these companies. For each release, prepare a sourced report showing reported results, industry metrics, and unresolved questions.
usageNote: Verify figures against company filings and release dates. Reports are for research, not financial advice or a substitute for your own investment decisions.
